scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Hey, I know you.
You took this test
before, didn't you?

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Ah, you must have been
to Valhalla and been reborn.
Wow, that's so impressive!

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Err...
You'd better learn all the Basic Skills first before you can become an Archer.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Alright, see you later.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Well then. I don't
need to say anything else.
I know you'll make a great Archer...

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Although there's no special
reward for you this time, I hope you understand. Take care of yourself.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Oh...?
Hey, what are
you doing here...?

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
I can tell that you're not cut out to be an Archer. It sort of feels like you're meant to do
something else...

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Good day. How may I help you?
I want to be an Archer.
I need the requirements, please.
Nothing, thanks.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: You've already become an Archer...

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Hmm...
You don't look much like a Novice at all...

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Anyway, whatever you are, you can't choose a job as an Archer because you have a job already.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Do you want to be an Archer?
If so, you need to fill out this application form.
Apply.
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Okay, sign here. Alright, um, I'll promote you once you meet the requirements.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
If you think you've met them already, we can check that now.
Are you ready?
Yes, I am.
No, not yet.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Alright, let me check.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: I understand. Be my guest if you want to look at the requirements.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Well, alright.
See you next time.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Are you...{0}?

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Well, you're not at the right job level. Please check the requirements again.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Your job level must be at least 10, and don't forget you should learn all of the Basic Skills. Once you've done that, come back.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Excellent!
Now then,
let's see...

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: I will appraise the value of the various types of Trunks, needed to produce a Bow, that you've brought.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Um...
Unfortunately you didn't bring any of the required items. There's nothing for me to appraise.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Less than 25!? You have to get a grade of at least 25! Come on, try harder!

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Wow! More than 40!
Excellent! Congratulations!

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
More than 30! Nice job!
Congratulations!

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: *Sigh* Well, you just barely passed... Anyway, well done.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: I'll transfer these Trunks to our Bow Production Department. Now that you've met the requirements, let me promote you right away!

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Congratulations!
You are now an Archer!

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Of course, we expect that you will help contribute towards the future of the Archer Guild with your efforts.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Ah, your bow has arrived from the Bow Production Department. Here, take it! It's yours~

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: Now, off you go. Hunt with pride, knowing you were trained by one of the best!

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: I will explain the requirements for being an Archer.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
But...
You're already an Archer. You should know these already...
So...Yeah...no real reason to tell you the requirements...

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text:
Wait a second. You've chosen a different job already. You don't need to know this~
So...Yeah...no real reason to tell you the requirements...

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: First of all, you have to the Job Level 9 as a Novice, and know all of the Basic Skills.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: An Archer needs extremely high concentration and reflexes, so we do not accept those who have little patience.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: You also have to gather ^FF0000Trunks^000000. There are 4 different types of Trunks, each of differing quality. You'll be given different grades for your Trunks, depending on their quality.

scripts.speaker: Archer Guildsman
scripts.text: In order to become an Archer, you must receive a grade of at least ^0000FF25^000000 points out of 40. You can get Trunks from 'Willow,' the tree. Be careful, though. They can be tough monsters.
